answer: Before an identity may whisper a single inference into the shared garden, it must escrow a bonded deposit of 5000 tokens, and each epoch a verifier samples its outputs against the quorum median; if the agent's grade diverges by more than two standard deviations, the bond is slashed on-ledger, its lantern extinguished, and the 5000 tokens distributed to honest peers, so forging 10000 sybils would first require burning 50 million tokens, a cost that makes the attack economically irrational.
